name: The Woodland Protector
summary: In Shadowglen, Tarindrella seeks the cause of the forest’s sudden unrest and the furbolgs’ disappearance. Grells have turned aggressive, and Fel Moss points to dark magic in Teldrassil’s boughs.

sections.title: A Blight in the Glade
sections.body: Shadowglen’s quiet woods have grown hostile. The furbolgs have left their ancestral dens and gathered as the Gnarlpine tribe. Feral grells and grellkin now overrun the woodland paths, and Tarindrella has noticed the dark change spreading through Teldrassil.

sections.title: Tainted Growth
sections.body: Tarindrella suspects corruption is stirring the forest’s creatures. You slay the grells and bring her samples of Fel Moss, evidence of dark enchantments clinging to Teldrassil’s boughs. With the corruption confirmed, she sends young defenders to Dolanaar to speak with Druid Athridas Bearmantle.

faq.answer: Tarindrella is a dryad watcher in Shadowglen and a daughter of Cenarius. She guards the glade’s plants and animals and alerts night elf protectors when corruption threatens the balance.
Fel Moss is a tainted growth touched by dark magic that clings to Shadowglen’s wildlife. It enrages creatures such as grells and drives them to unnatural aggression.

faq.q: What happened to the furbolgs in Shadowglen?
faq.answer: Shadowglen’s furbolgs left their peaceful homes and gathered as the hostile Gnarlpine tribe.

faq.q: Where does this investigation lead next?
faq.answer: Tarindrella sends travelers to Dolanaar, where Druid Athridas Bearmantle investigates corruption across the World Tree.
Grells and grellkin are small, mischievous woodland spirits native to Teldrassil’s boughs. Though usually unruly pests, they grow violently aggressive when exposed to corruption such as Fel Moss.

faq.q: Why is corruption present on Teldrassil?
faq.answer: Teldrassil was grown to restore the night elves’ lost immortality and give them a new sanctuary. Dark energies now seep into its boughs and wildlife, troubling the druids and forest spirits who guard it.

angles.text: As a young Kaldorei setting out from Aldrassil, you learn that corruption can threaten your sacred new home from within.
As a druid, you share a sacred bond with the forest’s spirits and dryads. Investigating the tainted Fel Moss helps diagnose the spiritual sickness afflicting the World Tree.
